question: 大桥街道常住人口总数是多少？
SQL: SELECT COUNT(p.person_id) AS total_count FROM ads_person_basic_info p INNER JOIN ads_residence_relation rr ON p.person_id = rr.person_id AND rr.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ads_house_basic_info h ON rr.house_id = h.house_id AND h.delete_flag = 0 WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 AND h.street = '310110018';

question: 大桥街道各居委的人口总数是多少,取前10名？
SQL: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS person_count FROM ads_person_basic_info p INNER JOIN ads_residence_relation rr ON p.person_id = rr.person_id AND rr.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ads_house_basic_info h ON rr.house_id = h.house_id AND h.delete_flag = 0 JOIN sys_dept d on d.dept_id = h.dept_id AND d.delete_flag = 0 WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 AND h.street = '310110018' GROUP BY d.dept_name,d.dept_id ORDER BY person_count DESC limit 10;

question: 大桥街道少数民族有多少人？
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS minority_count FROM ads_person_basic_info p INNER JOIN ads_residence_relation rr ON p.person_id = rr.person_id AND rr.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ads_house_basic_info h ON rr.house_id = h.house_id AND h.delete_flag = 0 WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 AND h.street = '310110018' AND p.ethnicity IS NOT NULL AND p.ethnicity != 1; -- 1=汉族

question: 大桥街道男女人数比例是多少？
SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS male_female_ratio FROM ads_person_basic_info p INNER JOIN ads_residence_relation rr ON p.person_id = rr.person_id AND rr.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ads_house_basic_info h ON rr.house_id = h.house_id AND h.delete_flag = 0 WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 AND h.street = '310110018';

question: 大桥街道各居委80岁以上的老人有多少，取前10名？
SQL: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS elderly_over_80_count FROM ads_person_basic_info p INNER JOIN ads_residence_relation rr ON p.person_id = rr.person_id AND rr.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ads_house_basic_info h ON rr.house_id = h.house_id AND h.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN sys_dept d on h.dept_id = d.dept_id AND d.delete_flag =0 WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 AND h.street = '310110018' AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 80 GROUP BY d.dept_name,d.dept_id ORDER BY elderly_over_80_count DESC limit 10;

question: 大桥街道户籍人员总数是多少？
SQL: select COUNT(distinct hr.person_id) as household_count from ads_household_registration hr inner join ads_house_basic_info h on hr.house_id = h.house_id and h.delete_flag = 0 where hr.delete_flag = 0 and h.street = '310110018';

question: 大桥街道各居委的房屋总数分别是多少？返回前10名
SQL: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(house_id) AS house_count FROM ads_house_basic_info h JOIN sys_dept d ON h.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE h.delete_flag = 0 AND d.delete_flag = 0 AND street = '310110018' GROUP BY d.dept_name,d.dept_id ORDER BY house_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 大桥街道有多少套房子是2000前造的？
SQL: SELECT COUNT(house_id) AS old_house_count FROM ads_house_basic_info WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND street = '310110018' AND build_year IS NOT NULL AND build_year < 2000;

question: 大桥街道各居委的独居老人数量分别是多少？返回前十名
SQL: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS elderly_alone_count FROM ads_person_basic_info p INNER JOIN ads_person_label_relation plr ON p.person_id = plr.person_id AND plr.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ads_label_info li ON plr.label_id = li.label_id AND li.delete_flag = 0 AND li.label_name = '独居老人' INNER JOIN ads_residence_relation rr ON p.person_id = rr.person_id AND rr.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ads_house_basic_info h ON rr.house_id = h.house_id AND h.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN sys_dept d on d.dept_id = h.dept_id AND d.delete_flag = 0 WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 AND h.street = '310110018' GROUP BY d.dept_name,d.dept_id ORDER BY d.dept_id;

question: 大桥街道周家牌居委、银河苑居委、临青居委的独居老人数量分别是多少？

question: 大桥街道退役军人有多少人？

question: 临青居委有没有百岁老人，有的话请给出年龄最大的10位人员的详细信息？
SQL: SELECT p.person_id, p.name, p.id_number, p.gender, p.ethnicity, p.birth_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, h.detailed_address FROM ads_person_basic_info p INNER JOIN ads_residence_relation rr ON p.person_id = rr.person_id AND rr.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ads_house_basic_info h ON rr.house_id = h.house_id AND h.delete_flag = 0 WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 AND h.dept_id = '310110018012' AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 100 ORDER BY age DESC limit 10;
